heads.t: 充滿英國色彩的小餐廳 2026/11/03 中正紀念堂庭園有個輕食小餐廳，供民眾休憩、吃些輕食。 這家小餐廳，最近大概換了新主人，有了新的布置，特別是充滿英國風；有紅色的電話亭、紅色的郵筒做為門面。電話亭和郵筒，都是現在人不常用的通訊或通信裝置了，卻顯得有古典的風貌。以前的電影超人，新聞記者克拉克，要執行拯救任務，都會躲進電話亭變裝成超人的呢！ 在這裡吃點輕食，休憩一下，是遊中正紀念堂的療癒景點之一。
heads.en: A small British restaurant, 2026/11/03, has a small restaurant at the Memorial Courtyard where people can rest and eat. This small restaurant, which has probably recently changed its owner, has a new layout, especially full of English wind; it has a red telephone booth and a red mailbox for the front. Telephone booths and mailboxes, which are not commonly used for communication or communication devices, are classical. Former movie superman, news reporter Clark, on a rescue mission, would hide in a phone booth and pretend to be Superman! heads.t: 鄉愁的集散地：東門市場 2026/11/03 逛過不少市場，從「亞洲最大集市」、兩千多年歷史的新疆喀什大巴扎，到美國西雅圖的派克市場（Pike Place Market），到加拿大、歐洲、日本、東南亞等地的市場，到台北市各區的市場。到頭來，還是故鄉金門金城的東門菜市場，最溫情，最令我眷念、低迴不已。 東門市場，在我金門生長歲月，扮演一個無法淡忘的角色，包孕我對母島無法言喻的一片真情。…
heads.en: Home-dwelling places: East Gate Market 2026/11/03 has travelled from the “largest market in Asia” to the 2,000-year-old New Quekash Grand Bassa to Pike Place Market in Seattle, to markets in Canada, Europe, Japan, Southeast Asia, and to markets in various parts of Taipei. In the end, it's the eastern market in the Golden City of Golden Gate, where I'm the most loving and the most humble. The East Gate Market, in my long life in Kimmen, played an unforgettable role in conceiving my inexplicable love for the mother island.

heads.t: 夢裡的童年身影 2026/11/03 昨夜，我夢見自己走進了一扇透明的門， 門後不是房間，也不是街道，而是一片光影交錯的奇境，天空像被水彩刷過，漂源浮著半透明的氣球，地面上長著會低語的花草，每一片葉子都閃著微弱的光。 在朦朧中，有一個熟悉的身影在跳躍｜那是我，童年的自己，她穿著舊舊的紅色運動鞋，笑的天真，無憂無慮。她一臉懵懂，還是一位尚未經歷人情世故的孩子。 「妳是誰？」她的聲音清脆，像夏日的風鈴。 我想上前抱住她，但每一步都像走在雲端，軟綿又恍惚。她拉著我的手，飛過彩色的河流，穿越長滿糖果樹的森林，一起在銀河上滑行。每一刻都讓我想起，那份純真和好奇心從未消失。…
heads.en: Last night, I dreamt of walking into a transparent door, not behind a room or a street, but in a strange space where the sky was painted by water, drifted into a semi-transparent balloon, and on the ground I grew with whispering flowers, and every leaf flashed a little light. There is a familiar figure in it, that is me, who was a child's own. She wears old red sneakers, and smiles innocently, without fear. She understood and was still a child who had not lived in love. "Who are you?" Her voice is clear, like a summer bell. I wanted to hold her up, but every step of the way was like walking in a cloud, soft and dull. She took my hand, flew across the coloured river, passed through the forest of sweet trees, and slipped together on the galaxy. Every moment reminds me that innocence and curiosity never disappear.
